column8: ["The broad ivory surface reads as a backing plate beneath the sockets; its blank expanses dominate the machine and leave it feeling generic.","The socket rims read as rusty terracotta with dark outlines, rather than rubbed brass and worn rubber; the ceramic also lacks a convincing glazed finish.","The perimeter has a bright upper-left lip and a shaded lower-right edge, giving the housing directional lighting that would rotate with the sprite."]
